citation: Porco et al. (2003), Cassini Imaging of Jupiter’s Atmosphere, Satellites, and Rings; JPL mean radius for model scale
semiAxesInterpretation: Modeled prolate ellipsoid: the projected Cassini ratio 150:120 is treated as intrinsic a:b, and unobserved depth is assumed equal to b. Axes are volume-normalized to JPL mean radius 85 km; these are not three measured axes.
qualification: Approximate elongated shape using Cassini’s observed 1.25:1 outline and JPL’s size estimate. Equal short axes and the viewing orientation are assumed. The gray grid marks unmapped terrain.
axisRatioInterpretation: Approximate elongation from a partly illuminated projected disk; viewing geometry and limb darkening prevent a unique intrinsic shape.
